acceptance_checks: Every manifest directory and file entry declares state_class.
scripts/shiki_state_classes.py classifies .shiki paths by exact file entry and longest directory prefix.
scripts/mergegate_check.py classifies changed .shiki paths and blocks unknown, workflow-runtime-evidence, cache, local-only, and non-append ledger mutations.
scripts/validate_shiki.py validates manifest state class definitions, policies, tracked/runtime consistency, unknown tracked .shiki paths, and docs coverage.
scripts/shiki_doctor.py reports state class manifest, unknown path, runtime-only, and append-only findings.
.shiki/migrations/state.json records M-20260605-0002-state-classes with no historical state rewrite.
docs/agents/state-classes.md and related docs explain class trust, tracking, mutation, MergeGate, doctor, and migration semantics.
scripts/test_shiki_state_classes.sh covers classification, validator, MergeGate, doctor, and migration behavior.
Verification bundle passes: validate_shiki, py_compile, scripts/test_shiki_*.sh, git diff --check, and state-class smoke.
